# Neighborhood Neurons Public Release

## Goal

Prepare a small public release package for a fictional community neuroscience art project called Neighborhood Neurons.

## Requested deliverables

- one webpage;
- one two-page teacher handout;
- one social post;
- a source and permissions checklist.

## Audience

Families, teachers, participating students, local supporters, and curious members of the public.

## Constraints

- Use only claims supported by the supplied project files.
- Keep the tone welcoming and scientifically responsible.
- Do not build a new app.
- Do not publish, deploy, contact participants, or send the social post without Amy's approval.
- A visual may not be used until its permission status is confirmed.
- The event must be described with the correct date.

## Current state

A draft announcement and source notes exist. No final artifact has been approved.

## Decision owner

Amy.
